8394509a3ae15408.src: Mash bills come only from producer-published specifications, and exist for a handful of bottlings. Cask links are either producer-published or derived by rule: a whole-word cask keyword in the bottling name (such as Sherry or Port), or the US legal requirement that bourbon and rye whiskey mature in new charred oak ({0} CFR {1}). Every bottling, producer, cask-link, mash-bill, tasting-note and price row carries a source ID into the data_sources provenance ledger (primary_source_id on spirits, source_id elsewhere). Apart from the documented ABV and bottle-volume defaults, an age statement, mash bill or cask link that no source states stays empty rather than guessed.
8394509a3ae15408.t: Las recetas de grano proceden únicamente de especificaciones publicadas por el productor y existen para un puñado de embotellados. Los vínculos de barrica los publica el productor o se derivan por reglas: una palabra clave de barrica completa en el nombre del embotellado (como Sherry o Port), o el requisito legal estadounidense de que el bourbon y el whiskey de centeno maduren en roble nuevo carbonizado ({0} CFR {1}). Cada fila de embotellado, productor, vínculo de barrica, receta de grano, nota de cata y precio lleva un ID de fuente que remite al registro de procedencia data_sources (primary_source_id en los destilados, source_id en las demás tablas). Salvo los valores predeterminados documentados de ABV y volumen de botella, cuando ninguna fuente indica una declaración de edad, una receta de grano o un vínculo de barrica, el campo queda vacío en lugar de suponerse.

a74a3ac81c569262.src: Each spirit record has a name, spirit type, ABV, bottle volume and a primary_source_id into the provenance ledger, and almost all carry a barcode or label ID and a distillery or producer link. Coverage is uneven, and stated plainly: {0} of the {1} spirits have an ABV other than {2}; the rest show {3}, either stated or the documented default for a source that states none. Bottle volume has documented defaults too: {4} mL on every US label-registry record, whose labels do not publish volume, and {5} mL on the curated seed rows and on Open Food Facts records without a stated quantity. Age statements are rare, and producer-published mash bills and flavor tags exist for only a handful of flagship bottlings.
